// RED fixture for `no-untagged-personal-data` — the GDPR-OWNED slice (P-GA-03 / P-051).
// The lint MUST reject this. This is the canonical "we forgot a store/field is a *structural*
// failure" bug class (gdpr-and-audit §2.1; ADR-12.1; GA-D5 drill): a personal-data-bearing schema
// field that lacks the `#[personal_data(...)]` classification escapes BOTH the generated data-map /
// RoPA inventory (Art. 30) AND the crypto-shred erasure fan-out (Art. 17) — an un-erasable,
// un-mapped subject. Here a DSR/consent registry row carries the data subject's contact + identity
// PII (`email`, `full_name`, `phone`) but NONE is tagged. The opaque `subject_ref` / `tenant` /
// `region` columns are correctly untagged (they are not personal data); only the PII columns must
// carry the §2.1 tag.
pub struct ConsentRow {
    pub subject_ref: SubjectRef,
    pub email: String,
    pub full_name: String,
    pub phone: String,
    pub tenant: TenantId,
    pub region: Region,
}
